claims.text: The hotel sits on a hill beside Kiyomizu-dera Temple, embraced by a bamboo forest.

findings.quote: Nestled on a hill beside the renowned Kiyomizu-dera Temple and embraced by a tranquil bamboo forest, Banyan Tree Higashiyama Kyoto hotel offers an intimate retreat.
findings.note: The page states both the hill beside Kiyomizu-dera and the bamboo forest.

claims.text: The Bamboo Pavilion at the heart of the property was designed by architect Kengo Kuma and is a stage for classical performances.

findings.quote: At the heart of the property stands the Bamboo Pavilion, designed by renowned architect Kengo Kuma and the only authentic stage in any Kyoto hotel, where classical performances unfold against a backdrop of quiet, profound beauty.
findings.note: Covers the location at the heart of the property, Kengo Kuma as designer and its use as a stage for classical performances.

claims.text: The natural onsen is drawn from a hot spring on the hilltop grounds and can be enjoyed in the public bath with indoor and open-air pools, in select rooms with a private onsen, and in the spa's treatment suites.

findings.quote: Drawn from a natural hot spring on the hilltop grounds, our Natural Onsen can be enjoyed in the public bath with indoor and open-air pools, in select guest rooms with a private onsen, and in the spa's treatment suites.
findings.note: Every element of the claim is stated.

claims.text: Rooms have tatami mat floors and garden or city views, with wooden soaking bathtubs, sitting areas and separate walk-in showers.

findings.quote: offers thoughtfully curated Kyoto accommodation with natural hot springs, tatami mat floors and breathtaking garden or city views.
findings.note: Covers the tatami floors and the garden or city views.

findings.quote: Other amenities of our Kyoto hotel rooms include wooden soaking bathtubs, cozy sitting areas and separate walk-in showers.
findings.note: Covers the bathtubs, sitting areas and walk-in showers.

claims.text: Wellbeing Sanctuary King rooms have a private yoga space and floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.

findings.quote: Rejuvenate in luxury with our plush King bed and private yoga space. Floor-to-ceiling windows reveal stunning city views while wooden soaking tubs enhance your wellness journey.
findings.note: The Wellbeing Sanctuary King description states both features.

claims.text: The Banyan Onsen Retreat, described as the hotel's most luxurious sanctuary, has a private natural onsen.

findings.quote: Our most luxurious sanctuary spans 74 square meters and features magnificent views and a private natural onsen.
findings.note: This is the Banyan Onsen Retreat King description.

findings.quote: Indulge in profound relaxation and serene pleasure with magnificent views and a private natural Onsen.
findings.note: The room page confirms the private natural onsen.

claims.text: The spa has natural hot springs and steam saunas.

findings.quote: Indulge in tranquil massage and spa facilities with natural hot springs and steam saunas.
findings.note: The spa page states both features.

findings.quote: Indulge in luxury massage and spa facilities with natural hot springs and steam saunas at our Kyoto hotel spa.
findings.note: The facilities page states the same.

claims.text: The Onsen Indulgence treatment, exclusive to this spa, combines a private onsen experience with a full-body treatment.

findings.quote: A Banyan Tree Spa Higashiyama Kyoto exclusive, this combination of a private onsen experience and a full-body treatment restores your vitality
findings.note: States the exclusivity and the combination of onsen and full-body treatment.

claims.text: The hotel has a bamboo garden of towering bamboo groves.

findings.quote: Step into our enchanting bamboo garden, where towering bamboo groves create a natural sanctuary of tranquility in the heart of Kyoto.
findings.note: The page describes the bamboo garden with towering bamboo groves.

claims.text: Geiko and maiko perform traditional dance with shamisen music against the backdrop of the hotel's Noh stage.

findings.quote: Experience the refined artistry of skilled geiko and maiko performing traditional dance accompanied by shamisen music against the backdrop of a historic Noh stage.
findings.note: Listed among the hotel's experiences.

findings.quote: It is the only hotel in Kyoto with a traditional Noh theater stage, “Bamboo Pavilion“, which is connected to its special location.
findings.note: Confirms the Noh stage belongs to the hotel.

claims.text: Ryozen, set beside the Bamboo Pavilion, offers kaiseki courses or counter dining with chefs cooking over the grill.

findings.quote: Set beside the tranquil Bamboo Pavilion, Ryozen is a Kyoto hotel restaurant defined by seasonality, artistry, and attentive hospitality.
findings.note: Covers the location beside the Bamboo Pavilion.

findings.quote: Guests may choose from refined kaiseki courses or immersive counter dining, where chefs prepare each course with quiet precision over the grill.
findings.note: Covers the kaiseki courses and counter dining over the grill.

claims.text: Ryozen SEN Bettei is a branch of Japanese Cuisine SEN serving creative kaiseki at a counter overlooking Higashiyama.

findings.quote: A cozy branch of the highly acclaimed “Japanese Cuisine SEN.” Enjoy creative kaiseki cuisine at a quiet counter seat overlooking the Higashiyama area.
findings.note: Every element of the claim is stated.

claims.text: The Bamboo Pavilion, designed by Kengo Kuma, stands at the heart of the property as a stage for classical performances.

findings.quote: At the heart of the property stands the Bamboo Pavilion, designed by renowned architect Kengo Kuma and the only authentic stage in any Kyoto hotel, where classical performances unfold against a backdrop of quiet, profound beauty.
findings.note: Every element of the claim is stated.

claims.text: Onsen water comes from a natural hot spring on the hilltop grounds, used in the public bath with indoor and open-air pools, private in-room onsen and spa treatment suites.

findings.quote: Drawn from a natural hot spring on the hilltop grounds, our Natural Onsen can be enjoyed in the public bath with indoor and open-air pools, in select guest rooms with a private onsen, and in the spa's treatment suites.
findings.note: Every element of the claim is stated.

claims.text: Onsen Retreat rooms have a private natural onsen and look onto a Japanese courtyard garden.

findings.quote: Set alongside a Japanese courtyard garden, the Onsen Retreats offers a rare Kyoto private onsen experience within a tranquil setting.
findings.note: Covers the Japanese courtyard garden and the private onsen.

findings.quote: A private natural onsen (hot spring) and courtyard garden views create an exclusive retreat layered in traditional tatami elegance.
findings.note: Confirms the onsen is natural and the room has courtyard garden views.

claims.text: The spa offers a private onsen experience in treatment rooms with traditional hinoki cypress bathtubs.

findings.quote: Indulge in an intimate hot spring retreat within our elegantly designed spa treatment rooms.
findings.note: Covers the private onsen experience in the treatment rooms.

findings.quote: As you soak in the traditional hinoki cypress bathtub, breathe in the gentle, naturally aromatic fragrance that emanates from the wood
findings.note: Covers the hinoki cypress bathtub.

claims.text: Noh performances are staged with masks illuminated by candlelight.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in the ethereal world of Noh, where haunting drum rhythms and mystical masks illuminated by candlelight create an unforgettable encounter
findings.note: The page describes masks illuminated by candlelight.

claims.text: The nearest airport is Kansai International.

findings.quote: Kansai International Airport (KIX) is the nearest airport to Banyan Tree Higashiyama Kyoto.
findings.note: Stated directly.
